ammonia.reason: Low deamination during 2-3 mo ripening; no surface flora urease activity.

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole from raw cow milk pasture; clean thermophilic starter dominates.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin and S. thermophilus/Lactobacillus proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium; low 2-heptanone ~93 ug/kg and 2-nonanone ~22 ug/kg from fatty-acid beta-oxidation.

browning.reason: Good Maillard of residual galactose and casein in low-moisture stretched curd when heated.

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl ~30 ug/kg from S. thermophilus citrate metabolism; acetoin ~400 ug/kg less potent.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate butanoic ~491 ug/kg and hexanoic ~397 ug/kg from rennet and microbial lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: Medium fat ~30% and moisture ~38% with fibrous pasta-filata matrix limits creaminess.

crumbliness.reason: Aligned stretched paracasein fibers give sliceable, fibrous fracture not short crumbly.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard from brine salting, moisture loss 46% to 38%, and hot-stretch contraction.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by NSLAB.

fruity.reason: Low-moderate ethyl acetate ~30-60 ug/kg and ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterase esterification.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in C6-C10 sharp acids; octanoic ~44 ug/kg gives only mild caprine sharpness.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-methylpropanal, 2/3-methylbutanal from Leu/Ile/Val by L. paracasei and aging proteolysis.

melt.reason: Excellent flow from demineralized pH 5.3 paracasein and ~30% fat; classic pasta-filata melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No bloomy or blue mold; negligible 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one lipid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free-oil release on melting from coalesced fat pools in aged stretched network.

smoky.reason: Typical version unsmoked; no wood-smoke guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic ~84 ug/kg headspace, ~27 ppm total plus lactic acid from thermophilic starter, pH ~5.3.

stretch.reason: Longitudinal calcium-paracasein alignment at pH 5.2-5.4 gives strong hot stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol/DMS from Met catabolism; hot-water stretching volatilizes sulfur notes.

sweet.reason: Lactose <LOQ; mild sweetness from free amino acids, glycerol and acetoin.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate release by chymosin/plasmin and Lactobacillus peptidases during ripening.
